tournament.name: BCDL Legacy Open 4 - Buffalo Chicken Dip

decks.notes: The deck focuses on quickly putting powerful creatures from the graveyard onto the battlefield using cards like Entomb, Reanimate, and Animate Dead. It also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Force of Will to protect the combo. The deck aims to win through overwhelming opponents with big threats such as Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, or by controlling the game with cards like Brazen Borrower and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student. The mana base is designed to support the deck's dual-color requirements while also including utility lands like Wasteland and Undercity Sewers.

The main strategy of this Cephalid Breakfast deck is to quickly assemble the combo pieces - Nomads en-Kor, Cephalid Illusionist, and Shuko - to mill the library and put Narcomoeba and Thassa's Oracle onto the battlefield. With the help of cards like Brainstorm and Force of Will for protection, the deck aims to win the game by either drawing a card with an empty library or using Dread Return to reanimate a game-winning threat. Urza's Saga provides additional utility and card advantage to support the combo.

This deck focuses on quickly getting out powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn by using the card Show and Tell to put them directly onto the battlefield. The deck also includes cards like Omniscience to allow for free casting of spells, and Atraxa, Grand Unifier to help control the board. The deck includes a mix of card draw, counterspells, and tutors to find the key pieces needed to combo off and win the game in a fast and explosive manner.

This deck focuses on quickly filling up the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, then bringing them back to the battlefield with cards like Reanimate and Animate Dead. By using cards like Brainstorm, Ponder, and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to dig through the deck and disrupt the opponent's plans with cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent with big threats while also controlling the game with counterspells and disruption.

The deck focuses on controlling the opponent's resources while utilizing lands as a key component of its strategy. By using cards like Life from the Loam to continually recur lands and cards like Crop Rotation to search for key lands like Dark Depths, the deck aims to outvalue and outgrind its opponent. With disruptive elements like Wasteland and Ghost Quarter, as well as utility lands like The Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while building its own powerful board presence.

The deck focuses on utilizing artifacts and mana acceleration to create a powerful combo with Mystic Forge, allowing the player to manipulate the top of their library and cast spells for free. Key components include mana ramp cards like Basalt Monolith and Grim Monolith, as well as cards like Voltaic Key and Manifold Key to untap artifacts for additional value. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Soul-Guide Lantern and Kozilek's Command to disrupt opponents' strategies. Overall, the deck aims to generate a powerful board state and overwhelm the opponent with efficient artifact plays.

The deck focuses on assembling a powerful board state using artifacts and mana acceleration, with Mystic Forge as a key card for combo potential. It utilizes cards like Grim Monolith and Mox Opal to generate large amounts of mana quickly, while also including cards like Manifold Key and Tangle Wire for control and disruption. The goal is to use Mystic Forge to dig through the deck and play powerful cards like Eldrazi Confluence and The One Ring to overwhelm the opponent. The deck also includes efficient creatures like Glaring Fleshraker and Foundry Inspector for additional pressure on the opponent.

The main concept of this deck is to overwhelm the opponent with aggressive creatures and spells while disrupting their strategy with counterspells and removal. The deck aims to control the tempo of the game by playing efficient threats like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent alongside disruptive spells like Force of Will and Daze. Additionally, cards like Mishra's Bauble and Brainstorm help dig through the deck for key pieces, while Wasteland provides additional disruption. Overall, the deck aims to apply pressure quickly while keeping the opponent off balance with its versatile spell suite.

This deck focuses on disrupting your opponent's game plan with spells like Thoughtseize and Daze while also maintaining control with cards like Force of Will and Fatal Push. It aims to quickly build a board presence with Murktide Regent and Nethergoyf, supported by Tamiyo and Orcish Bowmasters. The deck also utilizes card draw and manipulation through Brainstorm and Ponder to keep up the pressure. The mix of aggression and disruption creates a Tempo strategy that seeks to outpace and overpower the opponent before they can establish their own game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing lands and control elements to disrupt the opponent's game plan while ramping up mana and generating value. By utilizing cards like Life from the Loam, Exploration, and Crop Rotation, the deck can quickly assemble powerful land synergies such as Dark Depths and Thespian's Stage. The inclusion of disruptive elements like Wasteland and Pithing Needle further enhances the control aspect of the deck, allowing it to dictate the pace of the game and outmaneuver opponents. This deck excels at creating a resource advantage and overwhelming opponents with powerful land-based threats.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the Combo - Nadu archetype, centered around the card Nadu, Winged Wisdom. The deck aims to quickly assemble the necessary pieces for the combo, which can lead to explosive plays and victory. The deck includes support cards like Brainstorm, Force of Will, and Green Sun's Zenith to help find and protect the combo pieces. Additionally, the deck includes various utility lands and creatures to provide flexibility and adaptability in different situations. Overall, the goal is to efficiently execute the combo and outmaneuver opponents.

This deck aims to use the combo of Nomads en-Kor and Nadu, Winged Wisdom to create a loop of drawing cards and gaining life. It also utilizes small creatures like Scythecat Cub and Delighted Halfling to apply pressure on the opponent while controlling the board with cards like Swords to Plowshares and Force of Will. Green Sun's Zenith helps tutor for key pieces of the combo, while cards like Brainstorm and Ponder help with card selection and consistency. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Teferi, Time Raveler and Endurance to protect its game plan.

This deck focuses on quickly filling the graveyard with powerful creatures like Atraxa, Grand Unifier and Archon of Cruelty using cards like Entomb and Reanimate. It also includes disruption elements such as Force of Will and Thoughtseize to protect the combo. The goal is to quickly reanimate a big threat and overwhelm the opponent before they have a chance to respond. The mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, with a mix of fetch lands and dual lands. Overall, the deck aims to win through efficient graveyard manipulation and powerful reanimation spells.

The deck focuses on utilizing various reanimation spells and graveyard interaction to cheat powerful creatures into play early in the game. By combining cards like Entomb, Reanimate, and Animate Dead with strong creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Murktide Regent, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with threats that are difficult to deal with. The inclusion of countermagic like Force of Will and disruption like Thoughtseize ensures that the combo can be protected and executed smoothly. The deck also includes some versatile creatures and spells to provide flexibility and alternative win conditions.

This Legacy 1 vs 1 UR Tempo deck focuses on quickly deploying threats and disrupting the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal. The deck aims to control the board with cards like Dragon's Rage Channeler and Murktide Regent while also pressuring the opponent with efficient creatures like Brazen Borrower and Cori-Steel Cutter. By combining powerful spells like Brainstorm, Lightning Bolt, and Force of Will with efficient mana sources like Volcanic Island and fetch lands, the deck seeks to maintain tempo and pressure throughout the game. Wasteland is also included to disrupt the opponent's mana base.
